title: Iran conflict is 'a just war', Israeli opposition leader Lapid says
summary: As the US and Israel wage war on Iran, Israeli opposition leader and former prime minister Yair Lapid told FRANCE 24 he backs the current offensive, despite being "Netanyahu's biggest rival". Calling it "a just war," he argued that Tehran has "miscalculated" by attacking the Gulf states and that this has become "a war of the entire region against Iran."
